page.notes: The running head and the reference "6." after "Catechesi" are doubtful: the running head may read differently, and the "6." may be a reference mark rather than part of the text. The "[?]" on "omniaunum" and "præjudiciísque" is only a suspicion of spelling; the accents on "præjudiciísque" are uncertain. The long s has been normalised to s throughout.
